02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol-style categorical palette (#4477AA/#EE6677/#228833), restrained gridlines, and satisfying KDE diagonals lift this above generic, but diagonal label placement (rotated left-side labels cramped at 40px margin) and the undersized legend sitting hard against the bottom edge undercut the polish.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.encoding_integrity_note: Data-driven domains via d3.extent, principled Silverman bandwidth for KDE, zero-baseline area charts on diagonal, no radius/size deception, no dual axes — minor gap: no key functions on circle joins, but static brush pattern makes this non-critical.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.stress_test_note: The brush 'brush' event fires with no RAF or debounce, triggering a full data filter (200 points), 2400+ circle opacity mutations across 12 scatter cells, and KDE recomputation (900 kernel evaluations × 3 species) on every mousemove at up to 60fps; additionally, the brush has no touch event filter, risking double-trigger on mobile.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.cognitive_load_note: Well-executed SPLOM: 3-color palette separates cleanly, 150px cells are adequately sized, KDE diagonals break the grid rhythm, and brush linking across 16 cells is manageable because the matrix reads as one conceptual unit rather than 16 independent views.
